notes.title: Minor Bug Fixes
notes.notes: Fixed an issue with the bed soft locking the game when interacted with.

notes.title: Early Access Release Date!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that we have settled on a date, and Spacenoids will be releasing into Early Access on May 9th, 2025!

We have a few plans for the next build, v0.1.2, which includes the first version of the Hub World level, UI updates and some lore :3
